title: Peggy Orbon
bodyHtml:
Peggy Orbon divides her time between Scottsdale, Arizona and West Harwich, Massachusetts.  She is a member of the Oil Painters of America, the Arizona Pastel Artists Association, the Arizona Plein Air Painters, the Pastel Painters Society of Cape Cod and the Harwich Artists Guild.  She is also represented in the On the Edge Gallery in Scottsdale, Arizona.

Artist Statement

“I enjoy painting landscapes preferably on location.  On location (painting “en plein air”) the need to get the painting down quickly before the light changes too much keeps my painting fresh.  And, I find that painting the scene in front of me for a couple of hours helps me to remember the subtle details later. I often use these plein air paintings as a source when creating larger studio paintings.  My main focus and interest is on how to capture the light as it appears in a landscape.  I paint with oil or pastel.”
